$comment: Widget surface and handoff contract for the user-requested iOS, Android, and macOS implementations. This descriptive schema follows the other Shared/schema files; it is not a JSON Schema validator or a new cross-platform Prayer storage format.
windows: Native Windows widgets are outside this feature's requested scope; existing Prayer and Today data contracts remain unchanged.

today.date: Current local civil date, independent of any Today date selected in the app.
today.appleCompactAction: systemSmall and accessoryRectangular open Today; the Rosary shortcut appears in medium and large layouts.
today.configuration: Uses the app's calendar, Pascha style, interface language, and optional-row settings.

savedPrayer.selection: One existing Prayer.id per widget instance, selected through native widget configuration.
savedPrayer.action: Open the selected saved UUID through normal prayer navigation and existing continuation behavior.
savedPrayer.missingSelection: Prompt to choose a saved prayer. Do not silently substitute another saved configuration.
savedPrayer.identity: A rename keeps the UUID. A duplicate has a new UUID. Launch re-reads the current saved record.

feastCalendarId.source: Existing app setting and calendar registry
feastCalendarId.behavior: Select matching feast and lectionary datasets; never borrow readings from another rite.

language.source: Effective App Language selected through interfaceLanguageCode or the system preference
language.sourceFallback: Use the dataset's original source value when the selected-language value is absent.

todaySettings.headings: Where displayed, hide the supplementary heading on Sunday. Use season/week only for modern Roman lpj/roman; other rites use the civil date.

progress.source: Existing PrayerRunProgress, prayer engine, JesusPrayerTarget, and MultiDayRun; no widget-owned prayer progress.
progress.boundedTotal: Actual rebuilt engine step count, or the saved Jesus Prayer count target.

validation.signature: Must equal the signature for the selected saved configuration and current sequence.
validation.rosary: Also require savedLocalDate equal to the current local civil date.
validation.custom: Use normalized options, resolved run day, launch variant and bookmark language; the signature includes the effective language-owned variant.
validation.appleSeriesExpiry: A projected multi-day series checkpoint is valid only for the projection's local date; re-resolve the pending day in the app after midnight.
validation.missingPack: Do not display a sequence position when its required content cannot be rebuilt.
validation.onInvalid: Display the saved prayer without a continuation position; do not alter stored progress while rendering.

ownership.phoneCustomDevotion: Existing bundle/variant/day identity, validated against each selected saved configuration.
ownership.macCustomDevotion: PrayerCopyProgressIdentity.devotionID: saved UUID plus bundle ID.
ownership.macWindows: Widget reads the shared latest checkpoint; existing prayer windows retain their independent namespaces.

multiDay.choose: Resolve the missed day for the app's existing missed/next-day choice. Android omits checkpoint presentation while that choice is required.
multiDay.otherProgression: Retain the flow's normal selected-day behavior

progress.launch: Offer the existing Continue/Restart behavior and any missed-day choice. Widget interaction never increments progress or marks a day complete.

appleSnapshot.storage: JSON-encoded Codable Data in App Group UserDefaults

fields.updatedAt: Foundation Date, using the native Codable date strategy

WidgetSavedPrayer.name: String
WidgetSavedPrayer.stepIndex: Optional Int; only validated unfinished position
WidgetSavedPrayer.stepCount: Optional Int; null for unbounded repetition target
WidgetSavedPrayer.progressLocalDate: Optional yyyy-MM-dd local civil date: original bookmark date for Rosary, projection date for day-dependent custom series
WidgetSavedPrayer.progressExpiresAtMidnight: Bool, default false; true for day-dependent custom series

appleSnapshot.databaseBoundary: Extension never opens, migrates, copies, or synchronizes the host SwiftData database.
appleSnapshot.signing: Containing app and WidgetKit extension both require the App Groups capability and profiles granting the same group. The host embeds the extension.

android.storage: Widget instance selection is local; render content from existing app settings, saved-prayer store, prayer engine, checkpoints, and offline Today provider.
android.removal: Delete only that widget instance's configuration, never its saved Prayer or checkpoint.
android.configuration: Initial configuration Activity selects any saved prayer; existing widgets support reconfiguration.

refresh.midnight: Calculate next calendar-day start in the local time zone; do not add a fixed 24-hour duration.
refresh.schedule: The operating system controls actual rendering time. Launch always resolves current app data.
refresh.apple: Publish the current day plus seven future local-day entries; request reload after next local midnight.
refresh.android: Hourly OS update, inexact next-midnight alarm, date/time/zone/locale/boot/package-update events, coalesced app changes and app stop.

dataBoundary.attribution: Preserve the app's existing Calendar Data credits for every displayed source.
